assets.alt: Velocity v in m/s against position x in m: a straight line rising from 10 m/s at x = 0 to 50 m/s at x = 200 m, then constant at 50 m/s up to x = 400 m.

Four graphs of acceleration a in m/s² against x in m, labelled A to D, with 2 and 10 marked on the a-axis and 200 and 400 on the x-axis. A rises in a curve to 10 at 200, then stays at 10. B rises in a straight line from 2 to 10 at 200, then drops to zero. C rises in a straight line from 2 to 10 at 200, then stays at 10. D rises in a curve from 2 to 10 at 200 and stops there.
